Context: 11. Encashment of EL during L TC

2. The Government servants who are availing LTC facilities provided to their spouses employed in PSUs /Corporation/ Autonomous Bodies, etc., and who are availing privilege passes/ concessional tickets provided to their spouses employed in Indian Railways/National Airlines are also entitled to leave encashment subject to conditions. - GID (10), Rule 15.
